text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"automated_planner"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCoMn_screen_batch_B","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify plate state before campaign"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,20,0,0,20,40,0,0,0,0],"thickness":150},"comment":"standard NiFeCoMn quaternary, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":450,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"routine anneal within FTO-compatible window"},{"server":"echem","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,20,0,0,20,40,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"baseline CP, plate initialization assumed carried over from previous campaign session"},{"server":"echem","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12,"y":7},"comment":"spot check"},{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"housekeeping re-init after measurement"},{"server":"echem","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,20,0,0,20,40,0,0,0,0],"duration":2},"comment":"short stability check"},{"server":"model","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"batch_B"},"comment":"ingest results"}]}
